title: Lānaʻi Planning Commission return to in-person meetings
summary: As of May 20, staff said the planning director allows in-person meetings but does not want staff staying overnight. The chair asked staff to learn her position on hybrid meetings, and staff will ask why she opposes overnight stays. In April, a testifier asked for targeted funds for meetings in person and on Zoom.

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff will ask the planning director why she does not want overnight stays and what her position is on hybrid meetings.
Staff said the planning director allows in-person meetings but does not want staff to stay overnight.
A testifier asked for targeted funds so planning commission meetings can be held in person and on Zoom.
